name: anba-bishoy-church
description: Anba Bishoy Church member/visit tracking app (Capacitor Android wrapper)

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon
